author: Trikeri
body:
Please. When I play avicus, it seems dialed up to the max. I can't place blocks with efficiency, nor jump run up stairs. You should have moderation during the tournament, so why can't we disable a plugin which alters games. It would increase the quality of matches, so one doesn't constantly get kicked for flying. 

In addition, I believe that one of the semifinals games (Orphan Soup vs Nodus) last tournament faced a problem like this, and the game was forced to restart. 

Discuss.
